how_read: Each page below was opened live on 2026-11-17 (UTC) through the page-fetch tool (sandbox curl cannot reach casino hosts) and the quoted text was copied from the fetched page itself. Full transcript: research/594db405-verification-sweep.md. No value in this file is inferred or taken from an aggregator.

caesars_resort_fee_range.excerpt: Room reservations are subject to a daily resort fee between $45-$60 plus applicable tax. Resort fees are waived for Diamond and Seven Stars.
caesars_resort_fee_range.change: The upper bound moved from $50 to $60 between the 2026-11-16 read (session arena/e1c079dc-poker2) and the 2026-11-17 read of the same section. Search engine snippets still show the old $45-$50 text; the live page fetch is authoritative.
caesars_resort_fee_range.note: Only a range is published, so no single Caesars Palace or Horseshoe fee value is entered. Both property rows keep blank fee cells.

H-VEN.note: Read end to end (both chunks). Every tracked value matched: 13.38% Clark County Room Tax, $55 fee, $150/night incidentals, $20 guest self-park / $25 non-guest Fri-Sun / $40 valet, $50 extra guest 13+, $100 early departure, prepaid offers non-refundable.

H-PAL.note: Same shared Venetian Resort terms page as H-VEN; also cross-checked the poker suite-rate page ($119/$209, code EPOKR25, '$55 resort fee per night stayed', six-hour play or $300+ tournament per night).

H-WYN.note: 'Reservations will be charged a daily resort fee of $55 plus tax' and 'Complimentary self-parking for up to two vehicles' (Tower Suites: valet or self-parking). Match.

H-ARIA.note: Word-for-word match with the row's evidence: $55.00 fee, $150/day Deluxe incidentals, $50/occupant above 2, first-night deposit refundable with 72-hour notice (866.359.7757), 3pm/11am.

H-WG.note: Page body prints '$49.99 plus tax per night, though special discounts and exceptions may apply throughout the year'. The $36.99 figure attributed to this page by an earlier note does not appear in the body read today.

H-HS.note: Official page advertises 'FREE 48-Hour Cancellation*' and 'Reserve now. Pay at hotel. Free cancellation up to 48 hours before check-in.' No resort-fee amount is published on the property page; fee cell stays blank. The corporate disclaimer range (see change_records) is the only official figure available.

H-SP.note: 'Room rates are available with 4 hours of cash play for our out-of-town guests and parking is always free!' and 'tournaments daily with aggressive guarantees at 10:10 am, 2:10 pm, 6:10 pm and 10:10 pm with buy-ins of $120 and $300'. The daily-tournament-schedule page is image-only (JPG poster + JPG rules sheets) so per-time buy-in mapping stays unpublished.

wynn_guarantee_note.standard_policy_excerpt: A valid credit card is required to confirm your reservation. One night's room rate and tax will be charged at time of booking.
wynn_guarantee_note.note: The row's existing 'full deposit of all room nights and tax' quote is from three official offer-terms pages (terms-and-conditions/850257, /848703, /849723) and is offer-specific. The general guarantee policy charges one night. Both readings are kept: deposit exposure depends on the rate booked.

horseshoe_cancellation_quote.excerpt: Reserve now. Pay at hotel. Free cancellation up to 48 hours before check-in. Terms apply.
